name: golden
title: Unauthorized transfers on POST /api/transfers
safeguard: A customer can only move money out of accounts they own

name: declined-credit
title: Recipients credited for declined transfers
safeguard: A declined transfer changes no balances
variantLabel: The credit happens before the balance check

name: double-debit
title: Customers charged twice on retried transfers
safeguard: Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key charges once
variantLabel: Keys are saved under the source account

name: fee-overdraft
title: Accounts going negative after transfers
safeguard: The balance must cover the amount plus the fee
variantLabel: The balance check leaves out the fee

name: fee-quote
title: Fee quotes lower than the fee charged
safeguard: The quoted fee equals the fee charged
variantLabel: The quote uses round(), which rounds halves to even

name: fee-rounding
title: Transfer fees are being undercharged
safeguard: Fees round half up to whole cents
variantLabel: The fee is truncated through a float

name: float-amounts
title: Account balances with fractions of a cent
variantLabel: The amount field is typed as a float

name: history-incoming
title: Incoming transfers missing from account history
safeguard: Account history lists money in and money out

name: history-leak
title: Customers can read other customers' transfer history
safeguard: Only the owner can read an account's history

name: limit-units
title: Transfers above the $5,000 limit are going through
variantLabel: The limit compares dollars against cents

name: negative-amount
title: Negative transfers pull money from recipients
variantLabel: The amount check only rejects zero

name: shared-idempotency
title: Completed transfers that never moved any money
safeguard: Idempotency keys belong to one customer
variantLabel: Keys are saved without the customer
